_doc: stage3d: walking the floors in 3D (docs/gameplay/24_STAGE_3D.md). There is no 2D map: the game makes each floor's walls and ground from its tile map when the floor is entered (src/game/src/floor_mesh.cpp: a wall cell is a block wallHeight metres tall, one tile = one metre; the ground's texture repeats every groundRepeat metres), textured with its look's painted pictures (assets/media/stage3d/looks/<look>/, tools/stage3d/paint_looks.py).
loadingDelayMs: a scene still loading after this long (the floor's or the battle's 3D stage) shows the turning loading circle.
shadow: the soft disc under the hero, the monsters and the people (the battle's).

stairLights: the light of each stair, so it is not missed: up (colour, over its top step), down (colour, in its pit), intensity (x1.6 for a stair just opened, x0.5 for a locked one), range (metres), off. The stairs themselves are four steps in the floor's model (up to the walls' top, or down into a pit); stairShade darkens their treads (the ground's texture times it: 0.35 = about a third as bright as the floor).
viewScales: the steps of Settings > View size, x the camera's distance (1 = about 12 tiles across, 1.5 = 18, 2 = 24, 3 = 36).

camera: pitch (degrees down from level), distance (metres from the hero at view size 1), fov (degrees, up and down), follow (how fast it catches up with the hero: 1/s), lookAhead (metres north of the hero it looks at).

sprites: the map's sprites standing in the scene: glow (their own light), lean (degrees they lean back toward the camera; 0 = upright), heights (metres for a one-tile sprite, by kind: player, monster, npc, item, door, event, other), shadow (the soft disc's radius in metres; 0 = none), paintedHero (the hero drawn as his weapon's painted battle character, its idle clip, turned the way he last walked) and paintedHeroHeight (metres).

looks: by the floor's theme (its stage file's "theme"); a theme not here uses defaultLook. Each: sky (an HDR or JPG that lights the floor: hdr, intensity, yaw; background false = only light, the tower stands in the dark), exposure, light (the sun: dir, color, intensity, ambient) as battle.json stages3d.
